entities.name: Beate Bühler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Beate Bühler is a retired female volleyball player from Germany, who competed for West Germany at the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles, United States. There she ended up in sixth place with the national squad after a loss (0–3) in the last classification match against South Korea.
